caption: A shortest arc cd (purple) and opposite corner q are replaced using the unit-circle intersection p. The new body has five arcs; c and d become smooth points. Dashed blue is the previous boundary. Both bodies are constructed and checked as width-one Reuleaux polygons.
alt: An irregular seven-arc Reuleaux polygon and its five-arc replacement, with the shortest arc and points a, b, c, d, p, q labeled.
